reason: snapshots hold files only on every branch (checker.md 1.3.1 section 4); a mutant that records directories again fails atip_checkl2safety_05 (stampBareDir), _09 (peekBareDir) and the allowed-file case; the exec.rs unit test and atip.check.30 follow
summary: Differs from checker.md 1.3.1 section 4 (ATIP feedback): 'Snapshots count files only: a directory created to hold an allowed file is not an effect'. snapshot.rs records Entry::Dir and changed() reports directories (atip_check_30 asserts that an empty ~/.cache counts); only the read branch of L2.effects (safety.rs:560-566) drops a directory that holds a changed file, and its comment says a directory with nothing under it is an effect. So an empty directory made by a refusal, --dry-run, --help, a preview, schema or skills show fails where checker.md, read literally, passes it. Canon is the stricter, defensible reading (an empty directory is a cache); checker.md should say so or canon should count files only. Two reviewers found it independently.
